def row(x, n):
    return (x - 1) // n

def col(x, n):
    return (x - 1) % n

def diag1(x, n):
    r = row(x, n)
    c = col(x, n)
    return r == c

def diag2(x, n):
    r = row(x, n)
    c = col(x, n)
    return r + c == n - 1

n, t = [int(num) for num in input().split()]
lst = [int(num) for num in input().split()]
rows = [0 for _ in range(n)]
cols = [0 for _ in range(n)]
d1 = 0
d2 = 0
bingo = -1

for i in range(len(lst)):
    r = row(lst[i], n)
    c = col(lst[i], n)
    rows[r] += 1
    cols[c] += 1
    if diag1(lst[i], n):
        d1 += 1
    if diag2(lst[i], n):
        d2 += 1
    if rows[r] == n or cols[c] == n or d1 == n or d2 == n:
        bingo = i + 1
        break

print(bingo)
